objective: Exploratory, under the epic's frozen stop rule: on 12 of the 3,241 surviving product classes drawn at random (seed 1), test whether parent labels are forced, compute the product's labelled level-one collars from its factors and run arc consistency on them, and for the first three with off-law collars left, search tori from up to 20 of those collars each for a crystal (CRYSTAL-UP-20261108-001A-E002's method, each torus checked by a two-bit labelling of its cut). The line pauses after this test, whatever it shows.
status: Retired 2026-11-08 at the preliminary closure into the epic's stress test TWO-BIT-B1 (the same test). Folded in: E001 produced no result (a load-order failure, then two out-of-memory kills at about 59 GB); E002 passed its control and hit its 16 GB cap; E003 (vectorized) found parents forced and off-law parents surviving arc consistency in all 12 sampled survivors, and no crystal in its torus searches.
title: One bounded forcing test on the surviving products
